course.title: Mechanics of Solids - I
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: A portion of the floor plan of a certain building is shown in figure below. The total loading (including live and dead loads) in each bay is also shown. Determine the size of the section of the beams B-2 and B-3, if the allowable flexural stress is 150 MPa. Assume the beams are adequately braced and the depth of the cross section is 1.5 times of the width.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
